Class TestAgent

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.tt.Client
edu.uky.cs.nil.tt.TestAgent
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, Callable<String>
public class TestAgent extends edu.uky.cs.nil.tt.Client
A Tandem Tales agent that can play any world as either role, which makes fast random decisions, and which always chooses to let proposed actions succeed.

When it is this agent's turn:

  • If this is a normal turn, the agent chooses to pass based on PASS_PROBABILITY. If the agent does not choose to pass, it chooses a Turn.Type.SUCCEED or Turn.Type.PROPOSE turn uniformly at random.
  • If the previous turn was a proposal, the agent always chooses the first Turn.Type.SUCCEED action.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware
